```sql
WITH spend_nzd AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN s.currency = 'AUD' THEN s.spend_local * COALESCE(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
                ELSE s.spend_local
            END
        ) AS total_ad_spend
    FROM staging.stg_marketing__ad_spend AS s
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__fx_rates AS f ON s.spend_date = f.rate_date
    WHERE s.spend_date >= '2025-12-01' 
      AND s.spend_date <= '2025-12-31'
      AND LOWER(s.marketing_channel) = 'affiliate'
),
attributed_rev AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN o.currency = 'AUD' THEN (o.order_total - COALESCE(o.shipping_fee, 0)) * COALESCE(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
                ELSE (o.order_total - COALESCE(o.shipping_fee, 0))
            END
        ) AS total_attributed_revenue
    FROM staging.stg_ecom__orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__fx_rates AS f ON o.order_date = f.rate_date
    WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-12-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
      AND o.order_status <> 'cancelled'
      AND LOWER(o.marketing_channel) = 'affiliate'
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(s.total_ad_spend, 0) = 0 THEN 0.0
        ELSE COALESCE(r.total_attributed_revenue, 0.0) / s.total_ad_spend
    END AS answer
FROM spend_nzd AS s
CROSS JOIN attributed_rev AS r
```
